title: Opening Installment by Agreement Stage for a Security Deposit on a New Agreement
content:
The opening installment of a Security Deposit on a new agreement follows the stage of the Electric Service Agreement it secures, as the agreement's status and bills show on the payment date.

| Agreement stage | Deposit spread over more than one installment | Opening installment |
|---|---|---|
| Still pending start | Yes | The average monthly bill recorded on the deposit plus an equal share, over the number of installments, of the required amount less that bill, rounded down to the cent |
| Started, with no regular bill yet | Yes | One half of the required amount, rounded down to the cent |
| Any other stage, or a single installment | Either | The required amount divided by the number of installments, rounded down to the cent |

## Cases (hypothetical deposit: required amount USD 620.00, average monthly bill recorded USD 310.00, 3 installments)

| Agreement stage | Opening installment (USD) |
|---|---|
| Pending start | 310.00 plus one third of 310.00, that is 413.333..., rounded down to 413.33 |
| Active, no regular bill issued yet | 310.00 |
| Active, regular bills already issued | 206.66 |

**Single installment.** Where the deposit is paid in one installment, the opening installment is the required amount itself, whatever the stage.
